sources.label: Palencia Property Owners Association: Friendly Reminders notice (15 December 2016)
supports: "Section 8.1, Architectural Review and Approval ... The Palencia Architectural Review Board ("ARB") exists to review all designs and plans of all new homes and improvements to existing homes and landscaping. It is very important for each homeowner to contact the Palencia ARB prior to making any type of improvement or modification to the exterior of their property."

"Section 5.16, from the Declarations of Covenants and Restrictions for Palencia Lot Owners, Maintenance of Lots and Limited Common Areas ... 4) Replacement of Dead Plant Material ... Lawns that have been damaged by chinch bugs, fungus or any other infestations, will need to be replaced with sod grass in the affected areas immediately after treatment."
Letterhead: "Palencia Property Owners Association of St. Johns County, Inc. / 605 Palencia Club Drive, St. Augustine, Florida 32095"; document dated "December, 15 2016".
Verified absence: a full-text read of the notice returns no mention of artificial turf or synthetic grass.
